Two-line note is represented. The vertical stroke after the 'ū' with macron is present. The second line is indented. 'foliation' may be written abbreviated ('foliatn'). The underline under part of the title is noted.
Represented. On facing fol. 226, the c. 102 (3) entry ends 'n.d.: 74: …'. This agrees with '74 ff.' but does not prove the link.

Represented. The '3' of '3-30' is written raised or superscript-like, which the candidate does not note. The long arrow is at about y=1545-1595.
Isolated faint pencil 'a' with a macron above, at about [2860,2130,40,60]. Its attachment is uncertain.

Pencil word inside a drawn oval. The initial letter looks like a lowercase s with an acute accent, not clearly a capital. A short stroke runs along the top of the oval. Part of the oval is also visible in the fol. 226 overview at its left edge; that is the same feature, not a separate record.
